date.as_written: nobhranaya (!) munivarṣe māsasyaśrāvaṇastathā śitapakṣe tṛrodaśī (!) samāptaṃ kuca dinena

notes: The chronogram 'nobhranaya-muni-varṣe' contains muni (7) as the highest digit, but the first two terms are corrupt (perhaps nava-abhra-muni = 709 NS [c. 1589 CE] or abhra-nayana-muni = 720 NS [c. 1600 CE]). 'śrīvāṣṭaka' is likely a corruption of Śrīvāstavya (a Kāyastha subgroup). 'kuca dina' represents Kujadina (Tuesday).
